title: chore(release)!: enter Changesets pre mode (next) so 19.0.0 opens; retire the 18.6.0 i18n keys no code reads
body:
Fixes #37223

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under skills/ or content/docs names any of the 67 retired keys (git grep, each key)

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:合并后主干进入预发布阶段,下一次出版本得到 19.0.0-next.0;同时把 18.6.0 已发布、现已没有代码读取的 67 条界面文案在新大版本里声明退役。
- 属于「界面文案清理」大卡;按你「下一版是大版本 19.0.0」和「走预发布路线」两次裁决,照上一次开大版本(18)时的同款做法。
- 合并本身不发布任何东西:每一次预发布都要你批准才会发出,普通安装拿到的仍是 18.x;若有部署改写过这些文案,改写不再生效;在切出第一个预发布版之前,删掉三个新文件即可撤回。
- 要你做的两件事(按 7158089101 的裁决 A):① 合并前给本单加上 `allow-major` 标签,作为你对 19.0.0 大版本的人工确认;在加标签之前,「Check Changeset」因级别检查(`Metadata-protocol: none` 旁有 `major`)保持红色,属预期,门禁本身不改。② 由你亲自合并本单(和上次开 18 一样,席位只审不合)。

## What changes

1. **`.changeset/pre.json`**, written by `pnpm changeset pre enter next` (`@changesets/cli` 3.0.3) and committed as the tool wrote it: `{ "mode": "pre", "tag": "next" }`. ⛔ No `changeset version` output is committed, and nothing was published.
2. **`.changeset/37223-v19-line-opens.md`**, front matter `"@objectstack/spec": major`: the v19 line's opening note (rulings 7153326968 and 7153441862), `Clause-②: no`, and its ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition, in the form the v18 opening (#22084) used. Why spec: the protocol lockstep admits `PROTOCOL_VERSION` one major ahead only in pre mode WITH a pending `@objectstack/spec` major, and `scripts/sync-protocol-version.mjs` derives the protocol version from spec's major.
3. **`.changeset/37223-i18n-removed-released-keys.md`**, `'@object-ui/i18n': major`: the **BREAKING** banner, its own ADR-0087 disposition, and the 「Removed translation keys」 list (67 keys, each once, with its locales). Two majors in one `fixed` group still give one 19.0.0; the changeset says so.
4. **`ui/packages/i18n/scripts/released-keys-removed.mjs`** (zero third-party deps): reads the package's published catalogues out of git at the tag `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` and at a ref (default `origin/main`), and prints every key the tag has that the ref lacks, grouped by namespace, with the locales it was removed from. Which files are catalogues is read from the package: `package.json` `exports`, the all-packs door `src/locales/index.ts`, and each non-pack-shaped namespace's `index.ts` (`studio`).

No code change, no key restored, no `PROTOCOL_VERSION` edit, no `allow-major` label, no edit to `.changeset/config.json`, to either changeset guard, or to `release.yml`.

## Reproduction

```
$ node ui/packages/i18n/scripts/released-keys-removed.mjs
Keys in @object-ui/i18n@18.6.0 absent at origin/main (d15e439191): 67
## locales (32)    every one removed from all 11 locales (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant)
## studio (35)     every one removed from both locales the namespace ships (en, zh)
```

The 35 Studio keys are the ones the card expected (#36501, #36652). The 32 language-pack keys are extra; some of them are also named in earlier pending `patch` changesets, and this one lists the whole 18.6.0 set once for the major's notes. Keys that the open PRs #37169, #37166 and #37168 remove are still on main, so they are not reported or declared here. No non-test file under `ui/`, `apps/` or `packages/` quotes any of the 67 keys.

## The no-major guard reads `pre.json` from the head checkout

| Leg | Reading at `e43e989948` |
|---|---|
| As committed, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` | exit 0: `Changesets is in pre-release mode (tag: next) — major bumps are the expected product of an RC window; skipping the no-major guard.` |
| Control, `.changeset/pre.json` deleted from the working tree only | exit 1: `This PR introduces changeset(s) that declare a major bump.` |
| Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- .changeset/pre.json` | `git diff HEAD` empty (0 bytes), blob hash equals the HEAD blob, guard exit 0 again |

## Pins (throwaway detached worktree at `e43e989948`, never committed, removed after)

- `pnpm changeset version` exits 0. All 112 `fixed`-group members read `19.0.0-next.0`. `pre.json` is unchanged. `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` and `ui/packages/i18n/CHANGELOG.md` each open `## 19.0.0-next.0` / `### Major Changes`.
- `node scripts/sync-protocol-version.mjs` (the root `version` script's next step) rewrites `PROTOCOL_VERSION` in `packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts`: `PROTOCOL_VERSION 18.0.0 → 19.0.0 (lockstep with @objectstack/spec@19.0.0-next.0)`.
- `protocol-version.test.ts` on that tree: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 3 passed (3)`.

## `release.yml` in pre mode: `next` gets the prerelease, `latest` stays 18.x

A reading of the files; nothing edited, nothing run.

- Job `publish`, step `Publish to npm + push version tags` runs `pnpm run release`, which ends in `scripts/release-publish.sh`, which runs `changeset publish` with no `--tag`.
- `@changesets/cli` 3.0.3 `getReleaseTag` (`dist/getPublishPlan.mjs:599-601`): with a pre state and no `--tag`, the tag is `preState.tag` = `next`, unless every published version of a package is already a `next` prerelease. `dist/publish.mjs` refuses a custom tag in pre mode.
- `npm view` today: `@objectstack/spec` and `@object-ui/i18n` read `latest` = `18.6.0`, `next` = `0.0.0-next-20261125013212` (a snapshot, whose prerelease id is not `next`), so neither is "only-pre". Each publishes `19.0.0-next.0` to `next`; `latest` stays `18.6.0`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Open question: the level axis stays red.** `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`'s level axis refuses `Metadata-protocol: none` beside any entry at `minor` or above (verdict `none-minor`). It runs whatever the pre mode is, and only `allow-major` skips the step. Measured at `e43e989948` with a `pull_request` payload carrying this body's two lines: the no-major guard is exempt (pre mode), and the level axis exits 1. The v18 opening passed because its body had no `Metadata-protocol:` line. This PR changes neither the gate nor the declaration.
- **The version-PR lane refuses the protocol move.** `release.yml`'s `version-pr` validation marks a pass that rewrites `packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts` as UNVALIDATED and refuses it, because the example apps declare `engines.protocol: '^18'` (`examples/app-crm`, `app-showcase`, `app-todo`) and the ADR-0087 D1 handshake would refuse them under 19. So the version step would sync the constant, but that lane will not carry it: `PROTOCOL_VERSION` → 19.0.0 still needs its own reviewed PR (#37229), which should also move the example apps' `engines.protocol`. With this PR's pre mode and pending spec major, the protocol lockstep admits the constant one major ahead.
- `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates` is green with `pre.json` tracked (`2313 cases pass`), and the #22084 amendment (`CONSUMED_PRERELEASE_EXCLUDED` in `scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs`) is still on main. No gate script is edited.
- Landing: the maintainer merges (precedent #22084); seats review only. The PR stays draft.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` prints the pre-mode exemption line and exits 0; `node ui/packages/i18n/scripts/released-keys-removed.mjs` prints `67` on its first line.

Read first:
1. `.changeset/pre.json` and `.changeset/37223-v19-line-opens.md`: the line opening.
2. `.changeset/37223-i18n-removed-released-keys.md`: the list.
3. `ui/packages/i18n/scripts/released-keys-removed.mjs`, `discover()`.
